queries.title: Revenue, one value
queries.query:
EVALUATE
ROW ( "Revenue", [Revenue] )

queries.title: Sales by store country
queries.query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    'store'[CountryName],
    "Revenue", [Revenue]
)
ORDER BY [Revenue] DESC

queries.title: Sales by store country, with orders
queries.query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    'store'[CountryName],
    "Orders", [# Orders],
    "Revenue", [Revenue]
)
ORDER BY [Revenue] DESC

queries.title: Totals: sales, orders, customers
queries.query:
EVALUATE
ROW (
    "Revenue", [Revenue],
    "Orders", [# Orders],
    "Customers", [# Customers]
)

queries.title: Sales by product category
queries.query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    'product'[CategoryName],
    "Revenue", [Revenue]
)
ORDER BY [Revenue] DESC

queries.title: Sales and orders by year
queries.query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    'date'[Year],
    "Revenue", [Revenue],
    "Orders", [# Orders]
)
ORDER BY 'date'[Year]

queries.title: Sales by month
queries.query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    'date'[YearMonthNumber],
    'date'[YearMonthShort],
    "Revenue", [Revenue]
)
ORDER BY 'date'[YearMonthNumber]

queries.query:

)

queries.title: Margin %: the model's measure
queries.query:
EVALUATE
ROW ( "Margin %", [Margin %] )

queries.title: Margin %: written in the query
queries.query:
DEFINE
    MEASURE '_Measures'[App Margin %] =
        DIVIDE (
            SUMX ( sales, sales[Quantity] * ( sales[NetPrice] - sales[UnitCost] ) ),
            SUMX ( sales, sales[Quantity] * sales[NetPrice] )
        )
EVALUATE
ROW ( "Margin %", [App Margin %] )

queries.title: Margin %: written in the query, with a slip (list price)
queries.query:
DEFINE
    MEASURE '_Measures'[App Margin %] =
        DIVIDE (
            SUMX ( sales, sales[Quantity] * ( sales[UnitPrice] - sales[UnitCost] ) ),
            SUMX ( sales, sales[Quantity] * sales[NetPrice] )
        )
EVALUATE
ROW ( "Margin %", [App Margin %] )
